name: TA-9-dsm-disabled-nolayer
why: The other control for TA-9: the identical flat terrain and obstacleHeightThreshold (2 m), but no heightAboveGround layer supplied at all — no DSM was ever aligned to this DTM. §12 requires the layer AND the threshold both enabled before obstruction can block or penalize anything; with no DSM, obstruction must be inactive everywhere regardless of the threshold, and the route must go straight through.
